item.title: Data Center
item.description:
Waldur is used by Data center operators for automating sales of co-location space and Infrastructure-as-a-Service offerings.

The main benefits of using Waldur for Data centers are:

  • A web-based self-service tuned for use cases of a Data center.
  • Integrated billing with Paypal or in-house system.
  • Support of multiple identity providers: username/password, social, SAML.
  • Ability to provision services in a fully automated manner or through requests.
  • Usage dashboards highlighting current, historical and projected consumption of IT resources.

Implementation

To assure successful implementation of Waldur in a Data center, an agile and evolving approach is suggested. It allows to mitigate the risks related to integration and adoption by users.

item.title: Digital Marketplace
item.description: Waldur Digital Marketplace is an extension of the Waldur platform that allows to provide digital services from one organization to others in a transparent and zero-bureaucracy manner. In particular, it implements a concept of Digital Marketplace for the Government sector by allowing private sector to offer ready-made solutions according to the established policies that could be deployed in minutes and charged by the actual usage.

item.title: Government Cloud Solutions
item.description: Waldur Government Cloud Platform (GCP) is a state-of-the-art holistic solution for creating a hybrid cloud for the public sector services. It is targeted for operations by an IT authority and can scale from a department level to a cross-national one. Successful implementation of the government cloud means addressing needs of multiple stakeholders. GCP is a combination of policies, procedures and technology aimed at providing the customers with the best fit for their business requirements.

item.title: HPC Center
item.description: Waldur is used by HPC centers for offering a convenient self-service environment for research communities and R&D companies. HPC centers can integrate their SLURM or MOAB-based batch processing facilities, add OpenStack clouds and easily provide secure access to their customers.

item.title: NREN
item.description: Waldur is used by NREN centers for offering a convenient self-service environment for research communities and R&D companies. NREN can integrate their service offerings, including network and cloud services, and easily provide secure access to their customers. Moreover, NREN can offer Waldur as a platform for their customers to publish services in the Waldur’s Marketplace!

item.title: Self-service for Internal IT
item.description:
Waldur is used by Internal IT departments for offering a convenient self-service environment for company departments by providing a simple web-based catalogue of Internal IT services. Waldur integrates natively with Service Desk solution that Internal IT can be using so the introduction of Waldur is not affecting backoffice processes.

The main benefits of using Waldur for Internal IT departments are:

  • A web-based self-service tuned for use cases of Internal IT departments.
  • Ability for the end users to browse service offerings from Internal IT.
  • Support of multiple identity providers: local, LDAP, AD or SAML.
  • Non-intrsive integration with established Service Desk procedures.
  • Usage dashboards highlighting current, historical and projected consumption of IT resources by company departments.

Implementation

To assure successful implementation of Waldur in a Data center, an agile and evolving approach is suggested. It allows to mitigate the risks related to integration and adoption by users.
